comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of the peptide shows 47.4% similarity to Temporin 1ARa. GRAVY: 1.175; Mol Wt: 1730.135; Mol formula: C83H136N22O18. title: Parallel identification of novel antimicrobial peptide sequences from multiple anuran species by targeted DNA sequencing.
